pages.title: Antimatter
pages.text: The spark. Sealed capsules go in the Capsule Dock. Startup needs at least $(bold)2$(); the core holds up to 64.

pages.title: Antiparticle Foundry
pages.text: Fills one empty capsule an hour, drawing $(bold)400 kW$() the whole time. More foundries fill faster if the grid can feed them.$(br2)Helion sites sometimes hold a sealed capsule.

pages.title: Ordinary Matter
pages.text: The bulk fuel: cobblestone, dirt, any plain block, through the Matter Port. Hoppers can feed it.$(br2)If the matter runs out, output falls to nothing but no antimatter is lost.

pages.title: Core Charge
pages.text: Capsules only count once they are injected into the core. Sealed capsules in the dock are inert and safe to carry.$(br2)The Controller shows the blast radius for the charge in the core.
